5h idle audit found only one dream session had ever completed and memory consolidation was always zero; cooldown/idle detection and keyword+Titan FTS consolidation were repaired.
Hippocampus neural retrieval training attached to consolidation phase, making dream time an explicit low-priority cyclic learner slot.
Project Engine v3 introduced a separate project-agent Dream Cycle: nightly prune/learn/re-strategize/journal; related concept but not implementation-identical to Dream Daemon.

current_inheritance.inherit: Bounded low-priority cyclic worker; persisted phase/step checkpoint; immediate user-activity interruption; resource gate; exact resume; regressionize never-runs, no-op consolidation, malformed-output and lost-update failures.

Represent replay/consolidation as versioned event transactions with source-object provenance, expected-version/CAS semantics, effect receipts, rollback and idempotent resume. Never permit stale local singleton state to overwrite newer authoritative state.

Historical evidence supports a bounded cyclic background learning slot. Visual examples still obey current GOLD/SILVER provenance, shadow evaluation, open-set negatives, atomic promotion and rollback; self-generated dream output is not training truth.
Dream-synthesized hypotheses are candidate claims only. They require ordinary evidence/replay/falsification before broadcast authority or canonical integration.
Make cyclic jobs first-class resumable state machines with explicit budget/resource/effect types rather than hidden daemon conventions.

reject_or_adapt: Do not inherit keyword-match memory confidence boosts as epistemic confidence.
Do not inherit direct E-PQ homeostasis mutation without authority/version/provenance checks.
Do not treat successful phase completion as successful consolidation.
Do not promote LLM-generated dream hypotheses/reflections to truth or learner GOLD/SILVER data.
Do not silently assume user-idle when sensing fails; use explicit degraded/fail-safe policy.
Do not conflate Project Engine v3 Dream Cycle with the older Dream Daemon solely by shared naming.
cheap_discriminating_tests: Interrupt at every persisted phase/step boundary, restart process, assert exactly-once effects and identical terminal state.
Inject concurrent foreground state update during consolidation and assert stale writer cannot overwrite newer version.
Run cyclic learner with deliberately no matching memories and require NO_EFFECT receipt rather than success-by-phase-complete.
Feed malformed/truncated/self-contradictory synthesis JSON and require candidate quarantine, not canonical mutation.
Force idle-sensor failure and assert declared degraded policy rather than accidental background execution.
For adaptive visual learning, attempt BRONZE/self-generated example promotion and require rejection before candidate training.
